name: Squeezy Fish
tagline: Hold to puff. Release to dive.
description: Guide a pufferfish through an endless reef. Inflate for a bigger score, then deflate to squeeze through the coral and escape the shark.
features: Quick runs and another chance to beat your best

name: Doodle Legs
tagline: Your next great idea has legs.
description: Draw a pair of legs for NIBS and watch your scribble become a moving mechanism. Redraw mid-run to tackle an ever-changing obstacle course.
features: Draw the shape that moves your character
Experiment with loops, hooks and strides
Adapt your drawing as the obstacles change

name: AVERTED
tagline: Make a plan for the night sky.
description: Plan deep-sky observing around your telescope, eyepieces and observing conditions. Explore targets, arrange your night and keep an observation log.
features: Targets ranked for your equipment and sky
An observing plan from dusk to dawn
A log of the objects you have observed
